generationInputs.prompt: A dark room with bright, even lighting features a diamond-studded bed with a syringe on top and a man with light brown skin tone lying on it, with his hands on a large diamond. There is an abundance of white smoke and clouds adding mystery and luxury. Another man with light brown skin tone is depicted from the back, with dark hair, dressed in a purple swimming suit, standing and wearing a white glove. One wall is made of glass and the other is a giant mirror, reflecting the man lying down. Outside the room, another figure of the same man stands looking into the mirror.
